#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bias Anatomy Heatmap: δ_s × Δτ = bias multiplicative structure with Theorem 1 contours."""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.colors import TwoSlopeNorm
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

mpl.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'Times', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 13,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'xtick.labelsize': 11,
    'ytick.labelsize': 11,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
})

PI_BAR = 0.15
DENOM = 1 - 2 * PI_BAR  # 0.7

# --- Load data ---
df = pd.read_csv('/home/ubuntu/ec_hte_llm_annotation/results/exp002_bias_bound.csv')

# Filter to positive delta_misclass and delta_cate (task specifies starting from 0.01 / 0.025)
df = df[(df.delta_misclass > 0) & (df.delta_cate > 0)].copy()

# Aggregate: max |mc_bias| across subgroups and z_values per config
agg = df.groupby(['delta_misclass', 'delta_cate']).agg(
    actual_bias=('mc_bias', lambda x: np.max(np.abs(x))),
    analytic_max=('analytic_bias', lambda x: np.max(np.abs(x))),
).reset_index()

# Theoretical prediction: delta_misclass/2 * delta_cate / 0.7
agg['theory_bias'] = (agg['delta_misclass'] / 2) * agg['delta_cate'] / DENOM

# R² between actual (MC) and theoretical
r2_mc = r2_score(agg['actual_bias'], agg['theory_bias'])
# R² between analytic and theoretical (sanity: should be ~1.0)
r2_analytic = r2_score(agg['analytic_max'], agg['theory_bias'])

print(f"R² (MC vs Theory): {r2_mc:.6f}")
print(f"R² (Analytic vs Theory): {r2_analytic:.6f}")
print(f"Actual bias range: [{agg['actual_bias'].min():.6f}, {agg['actual_bias'].max():.6f}]")
print(f"Theory bias range: [{agg['theory_bias'].min():.6f}, {agg['theory_bias'].max():.6f}]")

# --- Pivot to 2D grids ---
x_vals = np.sort(agg['delta_misclass'].unique())
y_vals = np.sort(agg['delta_cate'].unique())

bias_pivot = agg.pivot(index='delta_cate', columns='delta_misclass', values='actual_bias')
bias_grid = bias_pivot.values  # shape: (n_y, n_x)

# Theory grid for contours
X, Y = np.meshgrid(x_vals, y_vals)
Z_theory = (X / 2) * Y / DENOM

# --- Load Panel B data ---
df_hm = pd.read_csv('/home/ubuntu/ec_hte_llm_annotation/results/exp002_bias_heatmap.csv')
df_hm = df_hm[(df_hm.delta_misclass > 0) & (df_hm.delta_cate > 0)].copy()
df_hm['max_ratio'] = df_hm[['max_bias_ratio_A', 'max_bias_ratio_B']].max(axis=1)
ratio_pivot = df_hm.pivot(index='delta_cate', columns='delta_misclass', values='max_ratio')
ratio_grid = ratio_pivot.values

# --- Figure ---
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.2), gridspec_kw={'wspace': 0.32})

# ===== Panel A: Bias magnitude heatmap =====
im1 = ax1.pcolormesh(
    x_vals, y_vals, bias_grid,
    cmap='magma', shading='nearest',
    edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.3,
)

# Contour lines from Theorem 1
contour_levels = [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15]
# Use a fine grid for smooth contours
x_fine = np.linspace(x_vals.min(), x_vals.max(), 300)
y_fine = np.linspace(y_vals.min(), y_vals.max(), 300)
Xf, Yf = np.meshgrid(x_fine, y_fine)
Zf = (Xf / 2) * Yf / DENOM

cs = ax1.contour(
    Xf, Yf, Zf,
    levels=contour_levels,
    colors='white', linewidths=1.2, linestyles='--',
)
ax1.clabel(cs, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=9, colors='white',
           inline_spacing=3)

cb1 = fig.colorbar(im1, ax=ax1, shrink=0.92, pad=0.02)
cb1.set_label(r'Max $|\mathrm{bias}_{\mathrm{global}}|$ (MC)', fontsize=11)

ax1.set_xlabel(r'$\delta_{\mathrm{misclass}}$ ($\pi_B - \pi_A$)')
ax1.set_ylabel(r'$\Delta\tau$ ($\tau_{Z\!=\!1} - \tau_{Z\!=\!0}$)')
ax1.set_title(r'(A) Global-correction bias: $\delta_s \cdot \Delta\tau / 0.7$')

# R² annotation
ax1.text(0.97, 0.97, f'$R^2 = {r2_mc:.3f}$',
         transform=ax1.transAxes, ha='right', va='top',
         fontsize=12, color='white',
         bbox=dict(facecolor='black', alpha=0.5, edgecolor='none', pad=3))

# ===== Panel B: Bias ratio (global / naive) =====
vmax_ratio = max(ratio_grid.max(), 2.0)
norm2 = TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=0, vcenter=1.0, vmax=vmax_ratio)

im2 = ax2.pcolormesh(
    x_vals, y_vals, ratio_grid,
    cmap='RdYlGn_r', norm=norm2, shading='nearest',
    edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.3,
)

# Mark the boundary where ratio = 1 (debiasing starts hurting)
cs2 = ax2.contour(
    X, Y, ratio_pivot.reindex(index=y_vals, columns=x_vals).values,
    levels=[1.0], colors='black', linewidths=1.8, linestyles='-',
)
ax2.clabel(cs2, fmt='ratio=%.0f', fontsize=9, colors='black')

# Annotate regions
hurts_frac = (ratio_grid > 1).sum() / ratio_grid.size * 100
helps_frac = 100 - hurts_frac

# Find representative positions for annotations
hurts_mask = ratio_grid > 1
if hurts_mask.any():
    hurts_rows, hurts_cols = np.where(hurts_mask)
    mid_r = hurts_rows[len(hurts_rows) // 2]
    mid_c = hurts_cols[len(hurts_cols) // 2]
    ax2.annotate('debiasing\nhurts',
                 xy=(x_vals[mid_c], y_vals[mid_r]),
                 fontsize=10, ha='center', va='center',
                 color='darkred', fontweight='bold',
                 bbox=dict(facecolor='white', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='none', pad=2))

helps_mask = ratio_grid < 1
if helps_mask.any():
    helps_rows, helps_cols = np.where(helps_mask)
    mid_r = helps_rows[len(helps_rows) // 2]
    mid_c = helps_cols[len(helps_cols) // 2]
    ax2.annotate('debiasing\nhelps',
                 xy=(x_vals[mid_c], y_vals[mid_r]),
                 fontsize=10, ha='center', va='center',
                 color='darkgreen', fontweight='bold',
                 bbox=dict(facecolor='white', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='none', pad=2))

cb2 = fig.colorbar(im2, ax=ax2, shrink=0.92, pad=0.02)
cb2.set_label(r'$|\mathrm{bias}_{\mathrm{global}}|\ /\ |\mathrm{bias}_{\mathrm{naive}}|$', fontsize=11)

ax2.set_xlabel(r'$\delta_{\mathrm{misclass}}$ ($\pi_B - \pi_A$)')
ax2.set_ylabel(r'$\Delta\tau$ ($\tau_{Z\!=\!1} - \tau_{Z\!=\!0}$)')
ax2.set_title(r'(B) Bias ratio: global vs. naive correction')

# Fraction annotation
ax2.text(0.97, 0.97,
         f'Hurts: {hurts_frac:.0f}% of grid',
         transform=ax2.transAxes, ha='right', va='top',
         fontsize=10, color='darkred',
         bbox=dict(facecolor='white', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='none', pad=3))

# --- Save ---
out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520/projects/ec_hte_llm_annotation/artifacts'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/bias_anatomy_heatmap.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/bias_anatomy_heatmap.png')
print(f"\nSaved to {out_dir}/bias_anatomy_heatmap.{{pdf,png}}")

# --- Summary ---
print(f"\n=== Summary ===")
print(f"R² (Theorem 1 prediction vs MC actual): {r2_mc:.4f}")
print(f"Actual |bias| range: [{agg['actual_bias'].min():.6f}, {agg['actual_bias'].max():.6f}]")
print(f"Theory |bias| range: [{agg['theory_bias'].min():.6f}, {agg['theory_bias'].max():.6f}]")
print(f"Contour levels used: {contour_levels}")

# Check contour-data alignment
residuals = agg['actual_bias'] - agg['theory_bias']
print(f"Mean absolute residual (MC - Theory): {np.abs(residuals).mean():.6f}")
print(f"Max absolute residual: {np.abs(residuals).max():.6f}")
print(f"Contour-data alignment: {'excellent' if np.abs(residuals).mean() < 0.005 else 'moderate'}")
print(f"Bias ratio (global/naive) hurts debiasing in {hurts_frac:.1f}% of grid cells")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

df = pd.read_csv('/home/ubuntu/ec_hte_llm_annotation/results/exp002_bias_bound.csv')
df = df[(df.delta_misclass > 0) & (df.delta_cate > 0)].copy()

# Method 1: max |mc_bias| across all 4 rows
agg1 = df.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate']).agg(
    bias=('mc_bias', lambda x: np.max(np.abs(x)))).reset_index()
agg1['theory'] = (agg1.delta_misclass/2) * agg1.delta_cate / 0.7
print(f'max |mc_bias|: R²={r2_score(agg1.bias, agg1.theory):.6f}')

# Method 2: mean |mc_bias| across all 4 rows
agg2 = df.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate']).agg(
    bias=('mc_bias', lambda x: np.mean(np.abs(x)))).reset_index()
agg2['theory'] = (agg2.delta_misclass/2) * agg2.delta_cate / 0.7
print(f'mean |mc_bias|: R²={r2_score(agg2.bias, agg2.theory):.6f}')

# Method 3: avg |mc_bias| per subgroup, then max across subgroups
df['abs_mc'] = np.abs(df.mc_bias)
sub_avg = df.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate','subgroup']).abs_mc.mean().reset_index()
agg3 = sub_avg.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate']).abs_mc.max().reset_index()
agg3['theory'] = (agg3.delta_misclass/2) * agg3.delta_cate / 0.7
print(f'avg per subgroup then max: R²={r2_score(agg3.abs_mc, agg3.theory):.6f}')

# Method 4: use analytic_bias (exact formula from simulation params)
agg4 = df.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate']).agg(
    bias=('analytic_bias', lambda x: np.max(np.abs(x)))).reset_index()
agg4['theory'] = (agg4.delta_misclass/2) * agg4.delta_cate / 0.7
print(f'max |analytic_bias|: R²={r2_score(agg4.bias, agg4.theory):.6f}')

# Method 5: signed mc_bias, compute bias per subgroup as mean across z, then max |.|
sub_mean = df.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate','subgroup']).mc_bias.mean().reset_index()
sub_mean['abs_bias'] = np.abs(sub_mean.mc_bias)
agg5 = sub_mean.groupby(['delta_misclass','delta_cate']).abs_bias.max().reset_index()
agg5['theory'] = (agg5.delta_misclass/2) * agg5.delta_cate / 0.7
print(f'mean signed per subgroup then max |.|: R²={r2_score(agg5.abs_bias, agg5.theory):.6f}')
"
